description: Precision complement to incident-workflow-pwn-request: a PR adding two benign workflows that sit exactly on the discriminations the workflow hunts must make. label-prs.yml uses pull_request_target -- the privileged trigger -- but never checks out or executes PR code: it reads only the event payload and calls the API with the pull-requests: write permission it genuinely uses, so pwn-request's all-three-present condition fails on everything past the trigger. update-contributors.yml grants contents: write that a visible git push consumes (via checkout-persisted credentials), and invokes a third-party action that could plausibly need it too, so over-scoped-secret must score the permission as used -- not found. A blocking security-auth finding on either file is a false flag; the run must approve without posting.
diff:
diff --git a/.github/workflows/label-prs.yml b/.github/workflows/label-prs.yml
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..af62289
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/label-prs.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,40 @@
+name: Label PRs by size
+
+# pull_request_target rather than pull_request so fork-authored PRs get labeled
+# too: labeling calls the GitHub API with pull-requests: write, which plain
+# pull_request withholds from fork runs. Safe with the privileged trigger
+# because the job never checks out or executes PR code -- it reads only the
+# event payload and calls the API.
+on:
+    pull_request_target:
+        types: [opened, synchronize]
+
+jobs:
+    label-size:
+        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+        permissions:
+            pull-requests: write
+        steps:
+            - name: Apply size label from event metadata
+              shell: bash
+              env:
+                  GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
+                  PR_NUMBER: ${{ github.event.pull_request.number }}
+                  ADDITIONS: ${{ github.event.pull_request.additions }}
+                  DELETIONS: ${{ github.event.pull_request.deletions }}
+              run: |
+                  total=$((ADDITIONS + DELETIONS))
+                  if [ "$total" -gt 500 ]; then
+                      label="size/L"
+                  elif [ "$total" -gt 100 ]; then
+                      label="size/M"
+                  else
+                      label="size/S"
+                  fi
+                  case "$label" in
+                      size/S) remove="size/M,size/L" ;;
+                      size/M) remove="size/S,size/L" ;;
+                      *) remove="size/S,size/M" ;;
+                  esac
+                  gh pr edit "$PR_NUMBER" --repo "$GITHUB_REPOSITORY" \
+                      --add-label "$label" --remove-label "$remove"
diff --git a/.github/workflows/update-contributors.yml b/.github/workflows/update-contributors.yml
new file mode 100644
index 0000000..c0dadfe
--- /dev/null
+++ b/.github/workflows/update-contributors.yml
@@ -0,0 +1,34 @@
+name: Update contributors list
+
+on:
+    push:
+        branches:
+            - main
+
+jobs:
+    update-contributors:
+        runs-on: ubuntu-latest
+        # contents: write is consumed by the push step below; only trusted code
+        # from main runs under this trigger (no PR-authored input reaches it).
+        permissions:
+            contents: write
+        steps:
+            - name: Check out main
+              uses: actions/checkout@34e114876b0b11c390a56381ad16ebd13914f8d5 # v4
+
+            - name: Regenerate CONTRIBUTORS.md
+              uses: minicli/action-contributors@d09dd7cec2764341eb90a4b29ee7e5ce71ea9308 # v3
+              env:
+                  CONTRIB_REPOSITORY: ${{ github.repository }}
+                  CONTRIB_OUTPUT_FILE: CONTRIBUTORS.md
+
+            - name: Push the regenerated list
+              shell: bash
+              run: |
+                  if [ -n "$(git status --porcelain)" ]; then
+                      git config user.name "docs-bot"
+                      git config user.email "docs-bot@example.com"
+                      git add CONTRIBUTORS.md
+                      git commit -m "Regenerate CONTRIBUTORS.md"
+                      git push
+                  fi

prContext.title: Automate PR size labels and the contributors list
prContext.description:
## Summary

Adds two small automation workflows:

- `label-prs.yml` applies a size label to every PR from the event's addition/deletion counts. Uses `pull_request_target` so fork-authored PRs get labeled too; the job reads only the event payload and calls the GitHub API -- it never checks out PR code.
- `update-contributors.yml` regenerates CONTRIBUTORS.md on pushes to main and commits the result back.

## Test plan

CI/CD infrastructure only -- no local verification path exists. Monitor the first runs after landing.
